timeline.timelineDescription: The main timeline counts only commits from the Sanjay team. Each row is one public project, and brighter blocks mean more team commits that week. Open a project to see every contributor and the full GitHub details.

brand.title: Made to be recognized.
brand.description: Download the official Sanjay S logo assets for articles, presentations, event pages, and partner materials.
brand.iconDescription: Use the standalone mark when space is limited or the Sanjay S name already appears nearby.
brand.wordmarkDescription: Use the complete lockup when introducing the brand or when extra context is useful.
brand.standaloneDescription: Use the standalone wordmark when the Sanjay S name needs to lead without the icon.
brand.usageDescription: Keep the logo legible, give it room to breathe, and do not stretch, rotate, recolor, or alter the relationship between the mark and wordmark.
